lines.text: Stop saying if I will be!
Many learners say: If I will be rich, I would travel.
Better: If I were rich, I would travel.
For dreams, use if plus past, then would.
Had! If I had a car, I would drive to work.

data.wrong: If I will be rich, I would travel.
data.right: If I were rich, I would travel.
data.why: For dreams, use if plus past, then would.
